_approach: The kick-drop section: kick removed entirely, replaced by a ride carrying the pulse in loud/soft 8ths and low/mid toms trading a loose call-and-response. A soft open hat and a rimshot ghost keep just enough top end alive that the return doesn't feel like total silence. This is the 'breathing room' section techno uses instead of a full musical breakdown. (re-voiced for the Vermona DRM1 MKIII's 8 channels)
